content: {"episode_id":"ep-05021","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer states is not covered under the member's benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), accompanied by a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy. We request reconsideration of the coverage determination and payment of the outstanding balance of 796.01."}
